title: First collision velocities
description: Essential: Correctly states the magnitudes of the velocities of the ball and disk immediately after the first collision as √(2gl)/2 for each.

title: Maximum separation distance
description: Essential: Correctly identifies the maximum separation between the ball and disk after the first collision as l.

title: Total collision count
description: Essential: Correctly states the total number of collisions as the disk moves through the tube is 4.

title: Energy and momentum application
description: Important: Applies conservation of energy to find the ball's speed before the first collision and conservation of momentum and relative speed reversal for elastic collisions.

title: Kinematics for separation
description: Important: Uses relative motion or kinematic equations to find the time and distance of maximum separation after the first collision.

title: Disk motion with friction
description: Important: Correctly models the disk's motion with constant kinetic friction (deceleration = g) between collisions.

title: Sequence analysis
description: Important: Systematically tracks velocities and positions after each collision to determine the collision count before the disk exits.

title: Sign error in velocities
description: Pitfall: Assigns incorrect signs to velocities (e.g., direction) after collisions, leading to wrong kinematics.

title: Friction or kinematics mistake
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly applies the friction force to the disk's acceleration or makes an error in the kinematic equations for relative motion.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Demonstrates unit analysis for velocities (√(gl)) and distances (l) to verify dimensional correctness.
